compatibility.dynamic.conjunction: You are the same sign. You recognise each other on sight and you share exactly the same blind spot, which means nobody in this pairing is going to be the adult about it.
compatibility.dynamic.opposition: You are the two ends of one axis. Everything you are missing, they are carrying — which is magnetic right up until it is the thing you fight about.
compatibility.dynamic.quincunx: Neither of you is wrong. You are running different software. Nearly all the damage in this pairing comes from deciding the other one is being difficult on purpose.
compatibility.dynamic.semiSextile: You sit next to each other on the wheel and have almost nothing in common. That is survivable. It just has to be chosen on purpose, over and over, rather than assumed.
compatibility.dynamic.sextile: This one is easy, and you may not trust it for exactly that reason. Somewhere along the way you were taught that real meant difficult. It does not.
compatibility.dynamic.square: There is friction here, and the friction is the attraction. You will not be bored. You will also have the same argument more than once before either of you admits it is the same one.
compatibility.dynamic.trine: You run on the same operating system. Things other people have to negotiate, the two of you will simply never need to discuss — which is its own risk, because unexamined is not the same as agreed.
compatibility.element.air+air: Two air signs. Endless conversation, and a shared talent for never quite having the difficult one.
compatibility.element.air+water: You explain feelings and they feel them. Translation is the work here, and it has to go both ways or it becomes a job.
compatibility.element.earth+air: One of you wants it decided and the other wants it discussed. That gap is not a phase. It is the relationship.
compatibility.element.earth+earth: Two earth signs. Unshowy, unhurried, and far harder to break than it looks from outside.
compatibility.element.earth+water: Water needs a bank to run along, and it has found one. This is the quietly durable pairing nobody makes films about.
compatibility.element.fire+air: Air feeds fire. This is the pairing that starts things. The open question is which of you finishes them.
compatibility.element.fire+earth: One of you moves and one of you builds. It works right up until the builder gets treated as the brake.
compatibility.element.fire+fire: Two fires. Bright, fast, and nobody in the house remembers to eat.
compatibility.element.fire+water: Fire and water. One of you burns it off, the other holds it. Neither of those is the wrong way to survive something.
compatibility.element.water+water: Two water signs. You will always know what the other is feeling, including the parts you would both rather skip.
compatibility.lopsided: One of you has already told their friends.
compatibility.power.even: Neither of you is running this, which sounds unremarkable and is the reason it might last.
compatibility.power.them: They set the terms. You will lose most of the arguments, and you will not always notice that you have.
compatibility.power.you: You set the terms here. They agreed to them a while ago, probably without either of you discussing it.
compatibility.pull.even: You want this about equally — which is genuinely the rarest result on this page.
compatibility.pull.them: They are further into this than you are, and both of you can feel it even if neither has said so.
compatibility.pull.you: You want this more than they do. That is not a flaw, but it is a fact, and pretending otherwise is where the trouble starts.
compatibility.punchline.depth: Neither of you walks away clean.
compatibility.punchline.drama: You will have this argument again.
compatibility.punchline.spark: The chemistry was never the problem.
compatibility.share.sextile: Easy — and neither of us trusts easy.
compatibility.watch.depth: This stays light. That is fine, as long as light is what you both actually came for.
compatibility.watch.drama: Nothing here will force anything into the open. This can drift for a year before either of you admits that it has.
compatibility.watch.future: This runs hot and can burn down to nothing. The work is having a version of it that holds on an ordinary Tuesday.
compatibility.watch.spark: The heat has to be fed on purpose. Comfortable is not the same as over, but left alone long enough the two look identical.
compatibility.watch.trust: Reassurance has to be said out loud, and then said again, past the point either of you thinks it should still be necessary.
compatibility.watch.vibe: You are at your best when something is happening. Empty afternoons are where this one actually gets tested.
compatibility.works.depth: This goes deep fast. Neither of you will be able to explain it accurately to a friend, and you will both try.
compatibility.works.drama: Nothing about this is boring. You will remember it whichever way it goes, which is more than most people get.
compatibility.works.future: This one survives being ordinary — the only test that actually matters, and the one most pairings quietly fail.
compatibility.works.spark: The chemistry is not in question. Whatever else the two of you have to work out, you will never have to manufacture wanting each other.
compatibility.works.trust: Neither of you has to perform safety here. It is simply present, and it is the rarest thing on this page.
compatibility.works.vibe: The ordinary days are good. Almost everybody underrates that until they have had the alternative.

reading.commitment.daily: Every morning. That was your word, not ours.
reading.commitment.most: Most days. Enough to build something.
reading.commitment.when: When you need it. It will be here either way.
reading.intention.calm: Your readings will be quiet on purpose. Less to think about, not more.
reading.intention.clarity: Your readings will keep returning you to the decision, until you stop circling it and make it.
reading.intention.love: Your readings will be written toward the people in your life — the ones you are trying to understand, and the one you are trying to become for them.
reading.intention.people: Your readings will be about the people around you, and what they are doing that you keep explaining away.
reading.intention.purpose: Your readings will stay on the long shape of it, not the noise of any particular week.
reading.intention.self: Your readings will tell you things about yourself that you already suspect and have not said out loud.
reading.opening.air: You live half a step ahead of the room, already three moves into a conversation nobody has started yet.
reading.opening.earth: You need the ground to hold before you put weight on it. People read that as slowness. It is not slowness.
reading.opening.fire: You move first and understand it afterwards. It has cost you things, and it has also been the only reason anything started.
reading.opening.water: You feel the temperature of a room before anyone speaks. You have been told this is too much. It is not too much.
reading.recognition.drained: You have been pouring out of a cup that nobody has refilled, and calling the emptiness a character flaw.
reading.recognition.letting_go: You are still carrying something that finished a while ago. Not because you are weak about it, but because nobody ever told you when you were allowed to put it down.
reading.recognition.mixed_signals: You are trying to read someone who is not being clear, and calling your confusion a failure of intuition. It is not. They are being unclear.
reading.recognition.racing: Your mind is moving faster than your day actually requires. The speed is not the problem. Having nowhere to put it is.
reading.recognition.repeating: You can already describe the pattern. That is the part people miss — you are not stuck because you cannot see it. You are stuck because seeing it was supposed to be enough.
reading.recognition.stuck: You are waiting to feel ready. Ready is something that arrives afterwards, which is an unfair way for it to work, and it is still how it works.
report.closing.charged: This is a charged pairing rather than a comfortable one, and the number reflects real intensity rather than real ease. Those are different things and this category habitually confuses them. What you do with the charge is not determined by anything in this document.
report.closing.hardwon: The numbers here are on the harder end. That is worth stating plainly rather than softening, and it is worth saying what it does not mean: this is a description of where the natural ease is and is not, not a verdict on whether two people can build something. Plenty of durable relationships score exactly here. They just did it deliberately.
report.closing.rare: Scores this high are uncommon, and the honest caveat is that a high number is a description of the raw material rather than a prediction about the outcome. Everything measured here is favourable. None of it is self-executing.
report.closing.strong: This is a strong pairing by the numbers, with the specific texture described above rather than a general glow. The axes that scored well will keep working with no effort from either of you. The one that scored lowest is the only one that requires any.
report.closing.workable: This is workable, which is a less exciting word than either of you wanted and a more accurate one than most reports would use. There is genuine material here alongside genuine friction, and the balance between them is not fixed.
report.facet.depth.high: Neither of you walks away clean. There is real weight here — the kind that makes someone hard to shake long after the sensible decision has been identified. Weight is not the same as rightness, and this is the number people most often mistake for love.
report.facet.depth.low: This one travels light. Neither of you is bound to the other by anything heavier than choosing it, which means it will last exactly as long as you both keep choosing it — and no longer. Some people want that. It is worth knowing which of you does.
report.facet.depth.mid: This has some gravity to it without being an anchor. You could end it and it would genuinely hurt, and you would both recover on a normal timescale. That is a healthier place to be than the alternative.
report.facet.drama.high: This one is volatile. The charge that makes it compelling is the same charge that makes the arguments disproportionate, and you will both mistake the intensity for significance more than once. Nothing here says it is bad. It does say it will never be quiet.
report.facet.drama.low: Very little combusts between you. That is restful, and it has a failure mode: low drama pairings are the ones where things go unsaid for years because saying them would be the most disruptive thing that had ever happened. Quiet is not the same as resolved.
report.facet.drama.mid: There is enough friction to keep it interesting and not so much that it runs the relationship. Conflict happens, resolves, and does not restructure everything on its way through.
report.facet.future.high: This survives being ordinary, which is the only durability test that matters. The structural stuff — the boring, load-bearing agreement about how a life is run — is already compatible. That is rarer than chemistry and far harder to acquire later.
report.facet.future.low: The structure is the weak point: what each of you takes seriously does not naturally line up. This is the axis that does not show up early and does not go away, because it is not about feeling. It is about how the two of you think a life should be organised.
report.facet.future.mid: The long-term architecture is workable and not automatic. You will have to build the practical agreements deliberately rather than discovering you already had them, and that is ordinary work rather than a warning.
report.facet.spark.high: The chemistry is not in question and never was. You will not have to manufacture wanting each other, which means it will never be the thing that ends this — and also that it will paper over things that should have been arguments. Notice what you stop discussing when it is easier not to.
report.facet.spark.low: Desire is not what is holding this together, and pretending otherwise will cost you more than admitting it. That is survivable — plenty of durable relationships score low here — but only if the two of you are honest about what is doing the work instead.
report.facet.spark.mid: There is real attraction here and it is not the loudest thing in the room. That is a better position than it feels like: pairings that run on chemistry alone tend to burn through it and find out what else was there, and you are already finding out.
report.facet.trust.high: You are liked, not just wanted, and the difference is the whole game. Whatever else has to be worked out, neither of you has to keep auditioning. That safety is the resource this pairing should be spending on the harder axes.
report.facet.trust.low: Wanting is outrunning liking here, and that gap is the thing to watch. It produces the specific pattern where the intensity is obvious to everyone and the security never arrives. It is fixable, but only by saying plain things out loud past the point where either of you thinks it should still be necessary.
report.facet.trust.mid: The regard is real and it is not automatic. Reassurance lands when it is given and it does have to be given — this is not a pairing where either of you can assume the other one simply knows.
report.facet.vibe.high: The ordinary days are good. This is the least glamorous number in the report and the one most worth having: it means an evening with nothing planned is genuinely pleasant rather than something to be filled. Most of what makes people stay is measured here.
report.facet.vibe.low: The everyday texture is the weak point. You can be very drawn to someone and still find a quiet Tuesday with them slightly hard work, and that is what this number is describing. It matters more over time than any of the loud ones do.
report.facet.vibe.mid: You are comfortable together without being effortless. Some days land, some days you are two people occupying the same room. That is the ordinary human range, and it responds to attention more than any other axis in this document.
report.mechanism.depth: Depth is Saturn against Venus. Saturn is the slow, heavy, one-way body — it is what makes something hard to walk away from, which is not the same thing as what makes it good.
report.mechanism.drama: Drama is Sun against Sun and Mars against Mars at the hard angles. It is volatility, not virtue: a high number here is not a compliment, and a low one is not an absence of feeling.
report.mechanism.future: Future is Saturn against the Sun in the flowing angles: whether this survives being ordinary. It is the axis that answers what happens after the interesting part.
report.mechanism.spark: Spark is Venus against Mars, in both directions — what each of you is drawn to, measured against how the other one pursues. It is the axis with the least to do with whether you like each other.
report.mechanism.trust: Trust is each Sun against the other's Venus — whether you are liked, as opposed to wanted. The two are separable, they are measured separately here, and the difference between them is where most of the damage in this category happens.
report.mechanism.vibe: Vibe is the Suns and the Venuses in the easy angles: whether an ordinary evening with nothing planned is pleasant. It is the least dramatic number in this document and the best predictor of whether you last.
report.moon.absent: This report is computed without the Moon, because one of you has no birth time on file. The Moon is the body that describes emotional register — what a person needs rather than what they want — and it moves thirteen degrees a day, so a birth date alone cannot place it. Adding a time to both charts would deepen this reading rather than change what is already here.
report.moon.charged: Your Moons are conjunct or opposed — amplified either way. Feelings do not stay one person's here; they cross over, fast, in both directions. That makes for unusual closeness and it means neither of you gets to have a bad day privately.
report.moon.flowing: Your Moons are in easy contact, which is the quietest good news in this document. Emotional register — what each of you needs rather than what you want — lines up without translation. You comfort each other correctly on instinct, and almost nobody does that.
report.moon.hard: Your Moons are at a hard angle. What each of you needs when things go wrong is genuinely different, and the failure mode is specific: you will both offer the comfort you would want, and neither of you will receive it. This is learnable, but only once it is named.
report.moon.none: Your Moons are not in contact. Emotionally you run on separate tracks — neither harmonised nor in conflict, just independent. That is more common than either of the alternatives and it means your emotional lives will not automatically synchronise.
report.opening.conjunction: You are the same sign, which is less romantic than it sounds and more useful than you think. Everything you understand about yourself applies to them, including the parts you would rather not have confirmed. The risk is not that you clash. It is that neither of you is holding the other to anything, because you both have the same excuse ready.
report.opening.opposition: You are opposite ends of the same axis, and that is why the pull is so hard to argue with. Each of you is carrying the half the other one dropped. It is magnetic, it is genuinely complementary, and it will feel like an accusation on the days when you are both tired.
report.opening.quincunx: Five signs apart is the awkward one. You are not opposites — opposites at least recognise each other — you are running different systems that share no obvious translation. Nothing about this is automatic. What you get in exchange, if you do the work, is a relationship neither of you could have predicted from your own side of it.
report.opening.semiSextile: You are next door to each other on the wheel, and neighbouring signs share almost nothing. There is no natural friction here and no natural ease either — just two people who have to build the bridge deliberately, every time. This works when both of you are paying attention. It goes quiet fast when only one of you is.
report.opening.sextile: This one is easy in a way that is genuinely rare, and easy is not the same as significant. You get on. You always got on. What you have to watch is whether either of you ever asks the relationship for anything difficult, because a pairing that is never tested can go a long way without anybody finding out what it is made of.
report.opening.square: This is a charged pairing and the charge is the point. You are working from incompatible instincts about the same things, which is why it is interesting and why it does not calm down. Expect the same argument in different clothes. The version of this that works is the one where you both stop trying to win it.
report.opening.trine: You run on the same operating system, and most of what other couples negotiate you will simply never discuss. That is the gift and the whole problem: unexamined is not the same as agreed. This pairing is at its most fragile precisely where it feels most effortless, because neither of you has ever had to say the thing out loud.
report.power.even: Neither of you is setting the terms. Authority moves depending on the subject, which is the healthiest configuration on this axis and also the one that requires the most ongoing negotiation.
report.power.them: They have slightly more say in how this runs. Not dominance — just a mild, persistent tilt in whose preference becomes the default when nobody argues.
report.power.themStrong: They set the terms. You will lose most of the arguments and you will not always notice that you have, because this dynamic does not feel like being overruled — it feels like their position simply being more reasonable. Check who has changed more since this started.
report.power.you: You have slightly more say in how this runs. It shows up in small defaults — whose plans move, whose preference gets assumed — rather than in anything either of you would call a decision.
report.power.youStrong: You set the terms here, and you may not have noticed. Saturn is the one-way body: the person holding it defines what is acceptable and the other one measures themselves against it, usually without either party naming the arrangement. You will win most of the arguments. Winning is not evidence that you were right.
report.pull.even: Neither of you is chasing. The wanting is genuinely mutual, which removes the most common source of low-grade damage in this category — nobody here is doing the arithmetic on who texted last.
report.pull.them: They are leaning in slightly further than you are. Not dramatically, but enough that they are more often the one who moves first, and enough that they probably know it.
report.pull.themStrong: They want this more than you do, clearly. One of you has already told their friends and it is not you. The thing worth being careful about is that this position is comfortable, and comfortable is how people end up accepting something they would not have chosen.
report.pull.you: You are leaning in slightly further than they are. It is a real difference rather than a decisive one, and it mostly shows up in who follows up first and who lets a silence run.
report.pull.youStrong: You want this more, and not by a small margin. That is not a flaw and it is not a verdict on your worth — it is a fact about the shape of this particular pairing, and the trouble starts when you spend energy pretending it is even. The practical cost is that you will read their ordinary neutrality as a signal, repeatedly, and be wrong most of the time.
report.watch.depth: Watch for staying because leaving is heavy. The weight on this axis is real, and weight is very easy to mistake for a reason. The question to keep asking is whether you would choose this today if you were not already in it.
report.watch.drama: Watch for the argument that reappears in different clothes. When the same disagreement comes back a third time with a new subject attached, you are not arguing about the subject and you have not been for a while.
report.watch.future: Watch for the practical conversations that keep getting postponed. Money, time, where a life happens — this pairing does not find these out naturally, and postponing them does not make them smaller.
report.watch.none: Nothing here is structurally weak, which is worth stating plainly rather than dressing up: on this pairing the lowest axis is still a working one. That does not mean there is nothing to watch. It means what goes wrong between you will come from circumstance and timing rather than from the shape of the two charts, and this document cannot see those.
report.watch.spark: Watch for the point where physical distance becomes the barometer for everything else. When this pairing gets strained, the wanting is the first thing to go quiet and the last thing either of you will mention.
report.watch.trust: Watch for reassurance becoming a chore. The pattern to catch is the one where the person who needs it stops asking, not because they stopped needing it but because asking started to feel like a failing.
report.watch.vibe: Watch the ordinary evenings, not the big occasions. This pairing performs well under structure — a plan, an event, something to do — and thins out in unstructured time. If you want to know how it is actually doing, look at a Sunday.
transit.headline: {transiting} {verb} {natal}
transit.opener.conjunction: These two are sitting on top of each other today.
transit.opener.opposition: You are being pulled two ways at once.
transit.opener.sextile: There is a quiet opening here.
transit.opener.square: Today has an edge to it.
transit.opener.trine: This one is easy, if you let it be.
transit.pair.jupiter.mars: Your appetite outruns your judgement today and mostly gets away with it. Mostly.
transit.pair.jupiter.saturn: The slow thing you have been building gets a little more room. Not a breakthrough — a door left open.
transit.pair.jupiter.sun: The room is wider today. Ask for the thing you decided last month was too much to ask for.
transit.pair.jupiter.venus: Generosity comes easily today, including toward yourself. Enjoy it. Do not sign anything.
transit.pair.mars.saturn: Pushing on the locked door is the temptation today. The door is not the problem; the wall beside it is thinner than it looks.
transit.pair.mars.sun: Something will need doing and you are the one who does it. Move early — the day gets less patient as it goes on.
transit.pair.mars.venus: You will want something and you will not be patient about it. That is not a flaw today, but it is a fact.
transit.pair.mercury.mars: You will win the argument. Consider, briefly, whether you want to.
transit.pair.mercury.saturn: The thought you keep circling will not resolve by being thought about again. Write it down, or say it to somebody.
transit.pair.mercury.sun: You will explain yourself today, probably more than once. The version you arrive at on the third attempt is the true one.
transit.pair.mercury.venus: Say the nice thing out loud. You have been assuming it was obvious, and it is not obvious.
transit.pair.saturn.mars: Your drive meets a wall this week, and the wall wins on points. Whatever survives that is the part worth keeping.
transit.pair.saturn.sun: This is one of the seasons that makes you. It will not feel like that while it is happening. It never does.
transit.pair.saturn.venus: Something you love is being asked to be real rather than lovely. That is not the same as it going wrong.
transit.pair.sun.mars: Your temper is nearer the surface than usual, and so is your nerve. Spend the second one before the first one spends you.
transit.pair.sun.saturn: Today asks whether you meant it — not dramatically, just in the small moment where you decide whether to do the thing you said you would.
transit.pair.sun.venus: The light is on what you want. Whatever you have been calling a preference is going to look a lot more like a need by this evening.
transit.pair.venus.mars: Wanting something and going after it line up today. That is rarer than it sounds, and it does not last.
transit.pair.venus.saturn: Affection today arrives with a condition attached. It is yours, not theirs, and it is worth knowing which one.
transit.pair.venus.sun: You are easier to be around today, and you will notice people responding to it before you notice why.
transit.quietDay: The sky is not doing anything to you today. Those days exist, and they are the ones things actually get finished on.
transit.retrograde.jupiter: Jupiter is retrograde. The growth is inward this time, which is less fun and considerably more useful.
transit.retrograde.mars: Mars is retrograde. Effort travels sideways rather than forward for a while. Push anyway if you must, but expect the angle.
transit.retrograde.mercury: Mercury is retrograde. Everything you send gets read twice — once by them, and once by you at two in the morning.
transit.retrograde.saturn: Saturn is retrograde. The thing you thought you had settled is asking to be settled properly.
transit.retrograde.venus: Venus is retrograde. Old names resurface. Answering is optional.
transit.retrogradeRerun: And it is retrograde, so this is a rerun — you have met this one before.
